block_size.description: Size of the blocks in bytes, usually the harddisk's error detection/correction unit size.

retry_count.description: Number of times to read a block before it is declared bad for this run.

skip_mode.description: Activate skip mode: exponentially increase stepsize on errors.

skip_failed_blocks.description: Skip blocks that have already had this many failures.

start_block.description: The number of the block to start with.

end_block.description: The number of the block where reading stops (exclusive). 0 means size of input-file / block-size.

reverse_direction.description: Reverse reading direction from end-block to start-block.

good_range.description: Only try to read blocks within this number of blocks from an already successfully read block.

failed_range.description: Extend skip-failed to also skip blocks within this range of a skipped block.

treat_slow_as_defective.description: Also avoid blocks that took an unusually long time to read.

jump_after_blocks.description: Randomly jump across the disc after reading this many blocks.

usb_device_file.description: Linux-specific: usb-device-file for bus reset after failed read attempt.

input_file.description: The source disk or image file to rescue data from.

output_file.description: The output file where rescued data will be written.
